The two products-page headings, "All products" and "Bundles", are now capitals, 16px, with 0.08em letter spacing. The functional tests pass (16/16), but the products screenshot tests fail at desktop and phone size. I didn't update the approved screenshots.

The change is a new `.page-products .section-title` rule at the end of `site/css/pages.css`. `.section-title` is shared with the other pages, so I scoped the rule to the products page. The other five pages' screenshot tests still pass, so nothing else moved.

The screenshot failures are expected. The headings are now smaller and uppercase, which changes the heading text and shifts everything below it up slightly. That is why the diff images show red across the whole page and not only on the headings.

If the new look is right, run `npx playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts --update-snapshots` to approve it. I held off because that overwrites the approved screenshots.

STATUS: DONE
